## GET DIAGNOSTIC (QQ) PLOTS (Supplemental Figure 4)

```{r}

# Genomic inflation in EWAS
  ## Extract p_values for (M3/Primary)
p_values9 <- rural_smk_8$P.Value
p_values10 <- schlyrs_m3$P.Value
p_values11 <- livegpar_smk_10$P.Value
p_values12 <- chsmk_ds$P.Value


  ## Extract lambda values (Model 3/Primary)
lambda_value9 <- calculate_lambda(p_values9)
lambda_value10 <- calculate_lambda(p_values10)
lambda_value11 <- calculate_lambda(p_values11)
lambda_value12 <- calculate_lambda(p_values12)



#Generate plots
  ## M3
qq_ruralm3 <- qq_plot2(p_values9, lambda_value9, "Grew up in a rural area")
qq_schlyrsm3 <- qq_plotschlyrs(p_values10, lambda_value10, "Years in school")
qq_livegparm3 <- qq_plot2(p_values11, lambda_value11, "Live with a grandparent")
qq_chsmkm3 <- qq_plot2(p_values12, lambda_value12, "Smoking during childhood")

# Combine
qq_plotsm3 <- plot_grid(qq_ruralm3, qq_schlyrsm3, qq_livegparm3, qq_chsmkm3, labels = c('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'), label_size = 28, ncol = 2)
qq_plotsm3

# Export
save_plot("Manuscript/20261601/Jan16_qq_plots_m3.png", qq_plotsm3, base_width = 18, base_height = 15, dpi = 1200, bg = "white")

```

## VOLCANO PLOTS (Figure 3)

### CHILD RURAL

```{r}

 ## M3
#Plot
plot.volcano <- function(rural_smk_8,main=NULL,xlim=NULL,ylim=NULL, nudge=0, title=""){par(mar=c(5,5,3,3))
#get betas and pvals from single sites results
betas <- rural_smk_8$logFCpercent
pvals <- -log(rural_smk_8$P.Value,10)
#assign colors
pcol <- ifelse(pvals < -log(0.05,10), 'darkslategrey', ifelse(betas>0,'#558899','#559999'))
#get percent hyper/hypo for sites above threshold
total <- table(pcol)['#558899'] + table(pcol)['#559999']
pct <- c(round(table(pcol)['#558899']/total * 100,1),round(table(pcol)['#559999']/total * 100,1))
#auto calculate axis range if not defined
if(is.null(xlim)){
  max.x <- max(abs(betas))
  xlim <- c(-max.x-0.05, max.x+0.05)
}
if(is.null(ylim)){
  ylim <- c(0,ifelse(max(pvals)<7, 7, max(pvals)+0.5))
}
df <- data.frame(betas=betas, pvals=pvals, col=pcol)
  ggplot(df, aes(x=betas, y=pvals, col=I(col))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) + ggtitle(title) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log(0.05, 10),color='blue') +
    geom_hline(yintercept=7,color='red') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = -0.12, xend = -0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0.12, xend = 0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) + 
    annotate("text", x = -1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.3, label = "Lower percent \n methylation", size = 10, hjust = 1.02) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.3, label = "Higher percent \n methylation", size = 10, hjust = -0.02) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(title=element_text(size = 28), axis.text=element_text(size=25), axis.title = element_text(size = 28)) +
    xlim(xlim) + ylim(ylim) +
    xlab(paste0('Adjusted difference in percent DNA methylation')) + ylab(expression('-Log'[10]*'(P-Value)')) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[2] - 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct[1],'%'), color='darkslategrey', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct[2],'%'), color='#558899', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 0) 
}
volcano_rural3 <- plot.volcano(rural_smk_8, ylim=c(0,15.3), xlim=c(-5,5), nudge=0.015, title = "A. Grew up in a rural area")

#Get Number with Higher and Lower Methylation
fdrp <- rural_smk_8[rural_smk_8$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]
sig <- rural_smk_8$P.Value < 0.05
betas_sig <- rural_smk_8$logFCpercent[sig]
rural_higher <- sum(betas_sig>0, na.rm=T)
rural_lower <- sum(betas_sig<0, na.rm=T)
rural_total <- length(betas_sig)
pct_higher_sig <- (rural_higher/rural_total)*100
pct_lower_sig <- (rural_lower/rural_total)*100

cat("Higher Methylation N:", rural_higher, "(",round(pct_higher_sig, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Lower Methylation N:", rural_lower, "(",round(pct_lower_sig, 2), "%)\n")

```

## SCATTER PLOTS (Supplemental Figure 5)

### COMPARE MODEL COEFFICENTS BETWEEN EXPOSURES (M3/Primary)

```{r, warning=FALSE}

png("Manuscript/20261601/Jan16_exposure-by-exposure-betas-scatter_allp.png", width=2800, height=1750, res = 300)

par(mfrow=c(2, 3), mar=c(5,5,2,2))

#rural x schlyrs
both.results <- rural_smk_8 %>%
  inner_join(schlyrs_m3, by="CpG", suffix=c(".rural_smk_8", ".schlyrs_m3")) %>%
  select(CpG, beta.rural_smk_8 = logFC.rural_smk_8, p.rural_smk_8 = P.Value.rural_smk_8, 
         beta.schlyrs_m3 = logFC.schlyrs_m3, p.schlyrs_m3 = P.Value.schlyrs_m3)
# All CpGs
smoothScatter(both.results$beta.rural_smk_8 ~ both.results$beta.schlyrs_m3, 
              xlab="Years in school", ylab="Grew up in a rural area", cex.lab=1.8, cex.axis=1.1)
cor_r <- cor(both.results$beta.rural_smk_8, both.results$beta.schlyrs_m3)
mtext(paste("r = ", round(cor_r, 3)), side=3, line=-1.8, adj=0.05, cex=1.3)


#rural x livegpar
both.results <- rural_smk_8 %>%
  inner_join(livegpar_smk_10, by="CpG", suffix=c(".rural_smk_8", ".livegpar_smk_10")) %>%
  select(CpG, beta.rural_smk_8 = logFC.rural_smk_8, p.rural_smk_8 = P.Value.rural_smk_8, 
         beta.livegpar_smk_10 = logFC.livegpar_smk_10, p.livegpar_smk_10 = P.Value.livegpar_smk_10)
# All CpGs
smoothScatter(both.results$beta.rural_smk_8 ~ both.results$beta.livegpar_smk_10, 
              xlab="Live with a grandparent", ylab="Grew up in a rural area", cex.lab=1.8, cex.axis=1.1)
cor_r <- cor(both.results$beta.rural_smk_8, both.results$beta.livegpar_smk_10)
mtext(paste("r = ", round(cor_r, 3)), side=3, line=-1.8, adj=0.05, cex=1.3)


#rural x chsmk
both.results <- rural_smk_8 %>%
  inner_join(chsmk_ds, by="CpG", suffix=c(".rural_smk_8", ".chsmk_ds")) %>%
  select(CpG, beta.rural_smk_8 = logFC.rural_smk_8, p.rural_smk_8 = P.Value.rural_smk_8, 
         beta.chsmk_ds = logFC.chsmk_ds, p.chsmk_ds = P.Value.chsmk_ds)
# All CpGs
smoothScatter(both.results$beta.rural_smk_8 ~ both.results$beta.chsmk_ds, 
              xlab="Smoking during childhood", ylab="Grew up in a rural area", cex.lab=1.8, cex.axis=1.1)
```

## OUTPUT RESULTS TO TABLE

### M3 PRIMARY models

```{r}

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Child Rural and DNAm: Adjusted for Model 2 Covariates + Smoking")
top_cpgs_rural_m3 <- rural_smk_8 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Years of School and DNAm: Adjusted for Model 2 Covariates + Smoking")
top_cpgs_schlyrsm3 <- schlyrs_m3 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Live with a Grandparent and DNAm: Adjusted for Model 2 Covariates + Smoking")
top_cpgs_livegparm3 <- livegpar_smk_10 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Child Smoking and DNAm: Adjusted for Model 2 Covariates + Drinking")
top_cpgs_chsmk_ds <- chsmk_ds %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)


#Set up individual exposure tables
#Primary
top_cpgs_m3_ruraltbl <-  top_tbl(top_cpgs_rural_m3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Grew up in a rural area and DNAm: Adjusted for model 2 covariates + smoking")
top_cpgs_m3_schlyrstbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_schlyrsm3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Years in school and DNAm: Adjusted for model 2 covariates + smoking")
top_cpgs_m3_livegpartbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_livegparm3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Live with a grandparent and DNAm: Adjusted for model 2 covariates + smoking")
top_cpgs_chsmkdstbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_chsmk_ds, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Smoking during childhood and DNAm: Adjusted for model 2 covariates + drinking")


gtsave(top_cpgs_m3_ruraltbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_ruraltbl_M32026Jan16.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_m3_schlyrstbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_schlyrstbl_M32026Jan16.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_m3_livegpartbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_livegpartbl_M32026Jan16.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_chsmkdstbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_chsmktbl_M32026Jan16.docx")
```
